metadata.name: Astryx Chat Tokenized Text
metadata.description: Renders a text string with token patterns replaced by inline token content. Wrap any message body inside ChatMessageBubble to turn raw @mentions, #tags, or /commands into styled content. When no non-empty token matches or none are provided, the text renders as-is, so you can use ChatTokenizedText unconditionally on every message.
